content.title: Stacked-Zone Relay | One Token, Multiple Route Handoffs
content.summary: Connect several readable zones in one space and launch one countable token from the first participant. Let visible surfaces change its route while later witnesses keep tracking it, then deliver it to an autonomous carrier and close on the complete path.

quick_start.input_format: At least 3 layered areas + 1 countable object + 2 route changes + rear redirection + autonomous carrier endpoint
quick_start.recommended_input: In the vertical seed bank, an amber capsule starts from the upper sorting arm, changes its route twice through the transparent slide and the mechanical leaf door, and finally falls into the autonomous planting vehicle.
required_anchors: Show at least three connected zones in one readable geography.
Launch one countable token from a clear first participant.
Keep the same token visible through a later witness zone and into its descending segment.
End with an autonomous final carrier and a wide path closure.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Connect several readable zones in one space and launch one countable token from the first participant. Let visible surfaces change its route while later witnesses keep tracking it, then deliver it to an autonomous carrier and close on the complete path.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish several connected zones in one readable geography, launch one small token from the first actor, let the token change route through visible surfaces while later witnesses keep tracking it, hand it to one autonomous final carrier, then close wide so the complete relay path is visible.

invariants.rule: Show at least three connected zones in one readable geography.
invariants.purpose: Lets each route change be followed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Isolated close-ups turn the relay into coincidence.

invariants.rule: Launch one countable token from a clear first participant.
invariants.purpose: Gives the chain a stable causal carrier.

invariants.rule: Change the token route at least twice without changing identity.
Keep the same token visible through a later witness zone and into its descending segment.
invariants.purpose: Bridges the middle route to the final carrier without inventing contact.
invariants.ablation_failure: Losing the token before descent makes the final handoff coincidental.

invariants.rule: End with an autonomous final carrier and a wide path closure.
invariants.purpose: Completes the chain and restores geography.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close endpoint hides whether the relay connected.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source cat, dog and robot vacuum
white ball, piano and domestic room
